title: 분리수거장에서: 이건 어디에 버리고요?
objective: You can ask how to throw away household waste and use -고요? to check one more thing.
summary: A new resident asks the security guard how to sort her trash.
setting: The recycling area of an apartment complex on a weekday evening.

task.title: Sort, ask, and complete
task.line: Use the dialogue and the expressions above to choose, fill in, order, or write the Korean.

words.meaning: an added question: "and ..., right?" Use it to check one more thing after the first answer
words.exampleMeaning: And milk cartons are collected separately from paper, right?

words.meaning: the recycling area of a building
words.exampleMeaning: The recycling area is next to the parking lot on the first floor.

words.example: 쓰레기는 밤에 문 앞에 내놓으면 아침에 가져가요.
words.exampleMeaning: If you put the trash out by the door at night, they take it in the morning.

words.example: 요구르트 병은 한 번 헹궈서 버리세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Rinse yogurt bottles once before you throw them out.

words.meaning: to peel off, remove (something stuck on)
words.exampleMeaning: I peeled off the sticker on the lunch box container.
I flattened the boxes and tied them with string.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 지난주에 이사 왔는데요, 분리배출은 언제 하면 돼요?
dialogue.meaning: Hello. I moved in last week. When should I put out the recycling?

dialogue.korean: 우리 아파트는 수요일하고 일요일 저녁에 여기 분리수거장에 내놓으시면 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: In our apartment, you can put it out here at the recycling area on Wednesday and Sunday evenings.

dialogue.korean: 아, 그렇군요. 페트병은 이 플라스틱 칸에 넣으면 되고요?
dialogue.meaning: Oh, I see. And plastic bottles go in this plastic section, right?

dialogue.korean: 네, 안을 물로 헹구고 라벨은 떼서 넣어 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes. Rinse the inside with water, take off the label, and then put it in.
What about delivery boxes? I take the tape off too, right?

dialogue.korean: 맞아요. 테이프랑 송장은 다 떼고 상자를 펴서 종이 칸에 놓으세요.
dialogue.meaning: That's right. Remove all the tape and shipping labels, flatten the box, and put it in the paper section.

exercises: Choose the right word: 컵라면 용기는 물로 한 번 (헹군 / 편) 다음에 버려요.
Fill in the blank with -고요 to add a question (넣다): A: 캔은 이 자루에 넣으면 돼요. B: 그럼 유리병도 여기에 ____?
Put the words in order to make a natural sentence: 떼고 / 우유팩은 / 빨대를 / 따로 모아요
Write in Korean: The guard says "스티로폼은 수요일에 내놓으세요." Use -고요? to check that you also need to remove the tape.
Choose the right word: 쓰레기 버리는 요일이 자꾸 (헷갈려서 / 내놓아서) 달력에 적어 놨어요.
answers: 우유팩은 빨대를 떼고 따로 모아요. (빨대를 떼고 우유팩은 따로 모아요.)
